overview.description: The Northern Trust 2036 Tax-Exempt Distributing Ladder ETF (MUNF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund seeks to provide regular cash distributions consisting of tax-exempt income and/or principal through an actively managed, laddered portfolio of US investment grade municipal bonds with various maturity dates through the year 2036. MUNF was launched on Aug 25, 2026 and is issued by Northern Trust.
